API Authentication & Token Management

All HTTP requests to the REST API must be authenticated over HTTPS using an API Bearer token in the Authorization request header.

Obtaining Your API Key

Generate a secure API key from your Developer Dashboard. Keep your secret keys confidential and never commit them into public version control repositories.

Authentication Headers

Include the token in your HTTP header formatted as follows:

Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_SECRET_KEY

Token Expiration & Rotation

Session tokens expire after 24 hours. For automated backend microservices, configure automatic refresh token exchange or use long-lived service account tokens with scoped permissions.
